Section 1-301 amends section 3(b) of Executive Order 12059 of May 11, 1978 so that the Panel for the District of Columbia Circuit also recommends nominees for the United States District Court for the District of Columbia using the standards of this order. Executive Order 12305 also revokes Executive Order 12059 as amended without naming this order; under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) that is a disclosed candidate earlier end for the reviewer and not an end, since the revocation of the parent does not name the amendment. No earlier express end was found.

Terminated by express revocation of the amended order. Executive Order 12305 of May 5, 1981 (46 FR 25421, Federal Register of May 7, 1981; held government printing) revokes Executive Order 12084 of September 27, 1978, as amended by Executive Order 12097 of November 8, 1978, and terminates the committee it created; the enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the end is dated on signing, 1981-05-05 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). This clause only amends Executive Order 12084, so it has no operation once that order is revoked. Section 1-302 amends Executive Order 12084 of September 27, 1978: paragraph (1) rewrites section 1-202(d) and paragraph (2) rewrites section 1-203 so that the Commission uses the standards of this order. Executive Order 12110 (December 28, 1978, effective December 31, 1978) continued the committee created by Executive Order 12084 until December 31, 1980; that continuance is a later event and not an end. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 later revoked this order by number; it is a later event because the clause had already ended. No earlier end was found.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 12097 (43 FR 52455, Federal Register of November 13, 1978; govinfo PDF text layer, grade original_representation_unverified, recorded as acceptable as original), headed Standards and Guidelines for the Merit Selection of United States District Judges and signed November 8, 1978. The dossier’s automatic split produced twelve fragments, including a duplicated group of subsections (a) to (c), and did not record sections 1-101, 1-102, 1-103, 1-105 and 1-301 as units. The operative commands are the eight numbered sections 1-101 to 1-105, 1-201, 1-301 and 1-302 of the original; the headings 1-1, 1-2 and 1-3 and the date line are not commands. Ending: Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12097, whose subject line describes standards and guidelines for the merit selection of United States district judges. Section 1-302 ended earlier, on 1981-05-05, because Executive Order 12305 revoked the order it amended, naming this order; the other seven clauses end on 1986-02-25 and the whole-order end is the later date. The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found citations of this number outside its own printings only in the printings of EO 12305. Searches: the OFR executive-order catalog search and the USC and eCFR citation searches were selected after reading their coverage notes (complete; no coverage warning; the USC edition runs through 2026-10-09 and the eCFR search to 2026-10-14, which cannot matter for an order whose end is shown in 1986 or earlier).
